name: BPC-157
class: Synthetic pentadecapeptide derived from a gastric juice protein

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A synthetic 15-amino-acid sequence corresponding to a fragment of human gastric juice protein BPC. Evidence is overwhelmingly preclinical, in rodent injury models. It has no FDA-approved product, no approved labelling, and appears on the FDA Category 2 bulk-substances list, which bars its use in compounding. No FDA label exists. Placed on the FDA 503A Category 2 bulk drug substances list. Not equivalent to any approved drug.

systems.note: Taken for connective-tissue and soft-tissue repair; this is the intended effect, evidenced almost entirely in rodent models.
No human safety data and no product-quality control; hepatic effect in humans is uncharacterised.
No human pharmacokinetic or clearance data exist.

monitors.why: No human safety record exists; baseline and interval hepatic panels are the only available surveillance.
The only accessible index of the systemic inflammatory effect claimed for it.
